title: Voice Media: Hold Music and Prompts for Your Queues | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
The audio your phone system plays, hold music for queues and recorded prompts for phone menus, has to sound the same for every caller, and a copy kept only at one phone provider is lost when you change provider. The voice media library in CrestApps for Orchard Core keeps a master copy of each clip on your site and sends a copy to your provider.

In this video:
• Why a voice media library
• Adding a clip
• What the Master copy, Provider copy only and No audio badges mean
• Replacing, protecting and re-syncing a clip
• Using a clip on a queue or in a phone menu
• Deleting a clip, and moving to another site
• Use cases
